text_koine: ὁ κοάλα καὶ ὁ δεινόσαυρος ἐν τῷ ἀγορᾷ περιπατοῦσιν.
text_english: the koala and the dinosaur walk in the agora.

text_koine: αὐτοὶ βλέπουσιν τὰς θύρας τῶν πόλεων.
text_english: they see the doors of the booths.
the koala points the hand.
the dinosaur listens to the koala.

text_koine: αὐτοὶ προσέρχονται πρὸς τὴν πρώτην θύραν.
text_english: they approach toward the first door.
the merchant says: «greetings!»

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα καὶ ὁ δεινόσαυρος λέγουσιν· «χαῖρε!»
text_english: the koala and the dinosaur say: «greetings!»
the merchant points the books.
the dinosaur sees the little book.
the koala takes the little book.

text_koine: αὐτοὶ περιπατοῦσιν πρὸς τὴν ἑτέραν θύραν.
text_english: they walk toward the other door.
the koala buys the apple.
the dinosaur eats the apple.

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα καὶ ὁ δεινόσαυρος πίνουσιν τὸν οἶνον.
text_english: the koala and the dinosaur drink the juice.
they listen to the music.
the koala dances.
the dinosaur dances.
they see the child.
the child says: «greetings!»

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα καὶ ὁ δεινόσαυρος λέγουσιν· «χαῖρε!»
text_english: the koala and the dinosaur say: «greetings!»
the child gives the ball.
the dinosaur takes the ball.

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα παίζει με τὸν κρόκον.
text_english: the koala plays with the ball.

text_koine: ὁ δεινόσαυρος παίζει με τὸν κρόκον.
text_english: the dinosaur plays with the ball.
they leave from the agora.

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα καὶ ὁ δεινόσαυρος ἐπανέρχονται εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.
text_english: the koala and the dinosaur return to the house.
the mother says: «where are you?»

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα λέγει· «ἐν τῷ ἀγορᾷ ἦμεν!»
text_english: the koala says: «we were in the agora!»
the mother says: «how did you do?»
the dinosaur says: «we did well!»
the koala points the little book.
the mother says: «good!»

text_koine: ὁ δεινόσαυρος δίδωσιν τὸν κρόκον τῷ κοάλᾳ.
text_english: the dinosaur gives the ball to the koala.

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα παίζει με τὸν κρόκον.
text_english: the koala plays with the ball.

text_koine: ὁ δεινόσαυρος παίζει με τὸν κρόκον.
text_english: the dinosaur plays with the ball.

text_koine: ἡ μήτηρ λέγει· «ἦρθεν ὁ καιρὸς τοῦ κοιμᾶσθαι!»
text_english: the mother says: «it is time to sleep!»

text_koine: ὁ κοάλα καὶ ὁ δεινόσαυρος κοιμῶνται.
text_english: the koala and the dinosaur sleep.
